meta.source_title: CompaniesMarketCap — Companies ranked by Market Cap
meta.selection: First 1000 source ranks; one listed company per row; no market-cap weighting

normalization.parenthetical: Removed for primary form; original preserved
normalization.diacritics: NFKD, combining marks removed; explicit Latin map
normalization.digits: Full A–Z form unavailable; digits never silently removed
normalization.typography: UPPERCASE is a spelling category, not proof of acronym origin
normalization.tokens: Latin words, apostrophes joined, hyphens/spaces separate words
normalization.frequency: Distinct companies per feature within selected eligible population; overlapping rows are not additive
